snippet.title: HYPERWIRED - Launch Trailer | Available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3234850/HYPERWIRED/

HYPERWIRED is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox! 🔌⚡

Experience a high-voltage, fast-paced roguelike space shooter with a twist: your ship is physically tethered by a cable to an energy source. To survive, you must manage your distance from the socket, dodge bullet-hell swarms, and balance your position to recharge your weapons. 

Main Features:
• High-Voltage Gameplay: Master the tactical risk-and-reward mechanics of your power cable while blasting through hordes of enemies.
• Infinite Roguelike Variety: Fight through randomized sectors, adapt to chaotic cosmic anomalies, and unlock game-changing weapon upgrades.
• Retro Arcade Vibe: Fully immerse yourself in a beautifully stylized pixel-art universe backed by a driving synthwave soundtrack.
